hooks.command: i=$(cat); for r in "$(printf '%s' "$i" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("cwd") or ".")' 2>/dev/null)" "$PWD" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; do r=$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -x "$r/.claude/hooks/lint-on-edit.sh" ] && break; r=; done; [ -n "$r" ] || { echo "lint-on-edit.sh: no checkout with .claude/hooks/lint-on-edit.sh at the session cwd" >&2; exit 1; }; printf '%s' "$i" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$r exec "$r/.claude/hooks/lint-on-edit.sh"

i=$(cat); for r in "$(printf '%s' "$i" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("cwd") or ".")' 2>/dev/null)" "$PWD" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; do r=$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -x "$r/.claude/hooks/gate-bash.sh" ] && break; r=; done; [ -n "$r" ] || { echo "gate-bash.sh: no checkout with .claude/hooks/gate-bash.sh at the session cwd" >&2; exit 1; }; printf '%s' "$i" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$r exec "$r/.claude/hooks/gate-bash.sh"
